decision: No acoustic model meets both mixture sensitivity and low false alarm rate on class/source-disjoint validation; do not change driving classifier or ship a fabricated int8 model.
latency_note: Acoustic context plus two 80ms updates only; USB, inference and task scheduling add further time. No P50/P95 onset timestamps are available.
remaining_research: Stronger general-audio pretraining and/or frontend retaining absolute energy and spatial cues, followed by independent field negative/impact/near-sound evaluation.
